name: Alabama Personal Data Protection Act
description: Alabama's comprehensive consumer privacy law. HB 351 (2026), signed April 17 2026, effective May 1 2027.
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by State of Alabama (alabama.gov) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within State of Alabama (alabama.gov).
